description: This file declares the GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient class, which implements a web audio player client using GStreamer. It includes method declarations for controlling playback, handling samples, and managing the player state, as well as callback structures and internal state variables.

classes.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: A class implementing a web audio player client using GStreamer, providing methods for controlling playback, handling samples, and managing state, with callback support.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the web audio player client with provided callbacks.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Extracts sample info from GStreamer capabilities and opens the web audio stream.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the web audio.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the web audio backend is open.

methods.name: notifyNewSample
methods.description: Handles notification of a new sample buffer from GStreamer.

methods.name: notifyPushSamplesTimerExpired
methods.description: Handles timer expiry for pushing samples.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Implements the callback for state change notifications.

methods.name: pushSamples
methods.description: Performs the next push operation of samples.

methods.name: isNewConfig
methods.description: Checks if the current configuration differs from the stored one.
